intro.t: An opinion on its own is too short. Give it a reason, or an example, and your answer suddenly sounds B2. Six ways to back it up.

close.t: Well done. From now on, every opinion gets a reason. Every single one.

reels.note: Simple and strong. The most useful word in Part 4.

ex.t: I think it's mostly good, {because} it brings jobs to places that need them.
ex.q: Is tourism good or bad for places like islands?

ex.t: It's popular {because} it's cheap, quick and, let's be honest, delicious.
ex.q: Why is fast food so popular?

ex.t: Not most jobs, {because} people will always want to talk to a real person.
ex.q: Will robots do most jobs in the future?

reels.note: One real example is worth three general sentences.

ex.t: Yes, we should. {For example,} lots of cheap clothes are only worn once or twice.
ex.q: Is fast fashion a problem we should care about?

ex.t: I think so. {For example,} some players earn more in a week than a nurse earns in a year.
ex.q: Are professional footballers paid too much?

ex.t: Not always. {For example,} my parents don't understand why I need my phone.
ex.q: Do teenagers and parents understand each other?

reels.p: The reason I think this is that …
reels.bt: The reason I think this is that…

ex.t: Better, I hope. {The reason I think this is that} medicine is improving so fast.
ex.q: Will life be better or worse in fifty years?

ex.t: Yes. {The reason I think this is that} unhealthy food is everywhere now.
ex.q: Is it harder to be healthy today than in the past?

ex.t: In some ways. {The reason I think this is that} we don't even walk to the shops any more.
ex.q: Do you think technology makes people lazy?

reels.note: Sounds like you have several, even if you only give one.

ex.t: {One reason is that} it's so easy to buy things online with one click.
ex.q: Why do some people find it hard to save money?

ex.t: {One reason is that} their lives look exciting compared with ours.
ex.q: Why do people like following celebrities?

ex.t: Yes. {One reason is that} people answer work emails even at home.
ex.q: Do you think people work too much these days?

reels.note: Connects your reason to a consequence: real argument.

ex.t: Yes. Fewer families would drive, and {this can lead to} cleaner air in cities.
ex.q: Should public transport be free for teenagers?

ex.t: I think so. Too much homework means less sleep, and {this can lead to} stress.
Yes, because exercise improves your mood, and {this can lead to} better marks.
ex.q: Should sport be compulsory at school?

reels.p: A good example of this is …
reels.bt: A good example of this is…
reels.note: A longer frame for your example. Sounds confident.

ex.t: In some ways it is. {A good example of this is} language apps, which really work.
ex.q: Is online learning as good as learning in a classroom?

ex.t: Quite a lot. {A good example of this is} the beach clean-ups organised by students.
ex.q: What can young people do to help the environment?

ex.t: It depends on the subject. {A good example of this is} maths, which I prefer to do alone.
ex.q: Is it better to study alone or with friends?
